scoring_justification: Cannot recompute DFT from raw outputs in the verifier sandbox. Agent reports formation energies and bond lengths; hidden checker compares to paper-reported reference values with domain-appropriate tolerances and verifies monotonic decrease and negativity at 30 V/nm.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference formation energies for fields 0,4,6,10,30 V/nm from Table I and Fig. 4(a) of the paper; bond lengths from Fig. 4(b).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper 'Electric field-induced oxygen vacancies in YBa2Cu3O7', J. Chem. Phys. 154, 224703 (2021), Table I and Fig. 4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: For fields 0,4,6,10 V/nm: exact values from Table I. For 30 V/nm: paper states negative, trend extrapolation gives ~-0.05 eV. Bond lengths: Cu-O_surface 1.85 Å, O_plane-O_surface 6.27 Å, directly from Fig. 4(b).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Numbers are direct extracts from the paper's published numerical data; no fabrication or guesswork.

outputs.description: Vacancy formation energies per vacancy for configuration (a) at five electric field strengths.
Cu-O_surface and O_plane-O_surface distances from the relaxed defective slab at 30 V/nm, showing bond lengthening.

output_contract.notes: The task reproduces the surface vacancy configuration (a) and the structural change at maximum field. Other defect configurations, band structure, CI-NEB, and field penetration analysis are omitted.

steps.description: Check formation energy values for each field within tolerance, verify strictly decreasing trend, and ensure negative at 30 V/nm.
Check bond lengths against paper-reported values for the 30 V/nm slab.
